question: If LAYMAN is coded as 2415026128 and ALGEBRA is coded as 1241424361, the how will FUNCTION be coded?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5d97b3d2fa188448002b3667ffe4686ba72894dd94ee5c8080578db5adf3030b.png] 

The pattern follows here is :

Positional values of **consonants** are getting **doubled.**

**Vowels** are having place values as per they appear in **vowel sequence.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c116a84c82d1ff96f59c28ab0b9a0e77f75806fea3eb3336fc04510d1cb5ec74.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/05d07c02f9f7b6255be737d7ae4c5b842899f37f8d4b0a93cf9cfff9713682df.png] 

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f97169b48f58a70cf5cab4e46e80ff5f4902692980ee9d6fca729c3ce52d4015.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"125286403428".**
